content: Biniyaame Sheeshi
Biniyaame bayra na7ay Beella; kaaloy Asbeela; heedzanthoy Ahira;
oyddanthoy Nohe; ichashanthoy Raafa.
Beella adde nayti Adaare, Geera, Abhuuda,
Abisu Na7imaane, Ahoha,
Geera, Safufaamanne Kiraama.
Ehuuda adde nayti Na7imaane, Akiyanne Geera. Enti Gib7an de7idanne guyepe Manahaata biitta di7etidi bida banta soo asaa halaqata. Enta yaa kaalethidi efiday Ozanne Ahuda aawa Geera.
Shaharaami ba macheta Hushimonne Ba7iira yeddidaape guye Moo7abe biittan adde nayta yelis.
Shaharaami ba mache Hodishipe Yobaaba, Dibaya, Meesa, Malkaama,
Ye7uxa, Sakiyaanne Mirma yelis. Iya nayti ubbay banta soo asaa halaqata gididosona.
I ba mache Hushimipe, Abixubanne Elfa7aala yelis.
Elfa7aala adde nayti Ebeera, Mashemanne Shameda. Shamedi Ononne Looda katamatanne enta heeran de7iya gutata keexis.
Shaharaami Beri7anne Shem77a yelis. Enti Eloona kataman de7iya banta soo asaa halaqata. Enti Geete kataman de7iya asaa gooddidosona.
Beri7a adde nayti Shaharaama, Ahiya, Shashaqa, Yiremoota.
Zabada, Arada, Edera,
Mika7eela, Yishphanne Yooha.
Elfala7a adde nayti Zabada, Masulaama, Hizqa, Hebeera,
Yishmaraya, Yuzilanne Yobaaba.
Same7a adde nayti Yaqma, Zikira, Zibada
Elanaya, Xiltaya, Elela,
Adaya, Birayanne Shimirata.
Shashaqa adde nayti Yishphana, Ebeera, Eli7eela,
Abdoona, Zikira, Hanaana,
Hanaaniya, Elama, Antota,
Yifdayanne Panu7eela.
Yirohaama adde nayti Shemshiraya, Shehaara, Ataala,
Yaaresha, Eelyiaasanne Zikira.
Haysati banta yeletan Yerusalaamen uttida banta soo asaa halaqata.
Gaba7oona aaway Yi7eeli Gaba7oona kataman de7is; iya mache sunthay Ma7iko.
Iya na7aa bayray Abdoona; hara iya adde nayti Xuraya, Qiisa, Ba7aala, Neeranne Nadaaba,
Gedoora, Ahiya, Zekeranne
Maqloota. Maqlooti Shim7a yelis. Haysati Yerusalaamen de7iya banta dabbota matan de7idosona.
Neeri Qiisa yelis; Qiisi Saa7ola yelis. Saa7oli Yoonataana, Malkisa, Abinadaabenne Asba7eela yelis.
Yoonataana na7ay Marba7aala yelis; Marba7aali Mikiyaasa yelis.
Mikiyaasa adde nayti Pitoona, Meleka, Tare7anne Akaaza.
Akaazi Yaho7ada yelis. Yaho7aadi Alemeeta, Azmaawetanne Zimira yelis. Zimiri Mooxa yelis;
Mooxi Bin7a yelis; Bin77i Raafa yelis; Raafi El7aasa yelis; El7aasi Axeela yelis.
Axeelas usupun adde nayti de7oosona. Enta sunthay Azirqaama, Bokeera, Isma7eela, Sha7aara, Abdiyunne Hanaana.
Axeela ishaa Esheqas heedzu nayti de7oosona. Iya na7ay bayray Ulama; kaaloy Yi7uusa; heedzanthoy Elfalaxa.
Ulama nayti wolqaamanne mino asi; enti dongen dukeyisata. Ulamas xeetanne ishatamu gidiya naytinne nayta nayti de7oosona. Haysati ubbay Biniyaame kochata.
